failure: Failure: No uniform bounded-use estimator under unrestricted black-box access; this does not imply impossibility with exact Choi input or promised support/spectral margin and is not a channel-capacity converse.
interface: Interface: Qubit amplitude-damping family approaching complete reset; black-box channel-use estimation with worst-case bounded uses and additive error below one half.

claims.title: The complete contraction coefficient jumps at pure reset and cannot be uniformly estimated with bounded channel uses
